# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Fill in the date, time, and inspector's name for each inspection record. 3. Under "Component" enter the word "Brake". 4. Under "Results" choose a Failure code from the list by clicking on the radio button. 5. Under "Details" make a concise, accurate statement of the facts supporting the Failure. The statement of Facts must include the following information: The type of brakes inspected The condition of the brakes The test conditions Results of the test If necessary provide related information, for example: "Brakes have a spongy pedal feel causing the pedal to travel to the floor before coming to a stop" 6. Under "Category" make sure "Failure" is selected from the drop down list. 7. Finally under "Comments" provide recommendations for the repair and/or a course of action for the customer.
